calculation.note: Exact slot-pool estimate from GGUF tensor shapes/types; excludes non-expert resident weights, KV/cache, compute buffers and allocator overhead. Normal generation uses 40 main layers; 41-layer figure is conservative because the GGUF includes blk.40 MTP tensors.

slots.risk: near memory ceiling; do not start automatically

caveats: The GGUF header and tensor descriptors are verified; full inference is not yet run.
Exact Metal allocation may differ from descriptor bytes because pools are backend tensors with alignment/allocator overhead.
The offloader binds main generation layers; MTP blk.40 may not be used in the initial text-only path.
Non-expert weights, recurrent state, KV/cache and compute buffers remain unmeasured.
